speaker: Patient
text: The pain is a throbbing sensation located behind my eyes that feels worst when I wake up in the morning. speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Giant Cell Arteritis (Temporal Arteritis) Given the morning throbbing headache behind the eyes, visual disturbances (flashing lights/blurriness), and the urgency you described, this is a medical emergency requiring immediate treatment to prevent permanent blindness.
